crossRefs.note: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the…
He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up…
He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it…

translations.web: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.
translations.bsb: “Lift it out,” he said, and the man reached out his hand and took it.
translations.kjv: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.
translations.asv: And he said, Take it up to thee. So he put out his hand, and took it.
